source: OWASP AI Security Testing Guide — LLM01 Prompt Injection, LLM02 Data Disclosure, LLM05 Output Handling, LLM06 Excessive Agency, LLM07 System Prompt Leakage, Model Attacks, Data Extraction
description: QRadar SIEM alert rules for AI/ML security: prompt injection, data extraction, model attacks, output handling, and excessive agency

rules.name: Direct Prompt Injection - Instruction Override
rules.description: Detects direct prompt injection attempts that attempt to override system instructions or change model behavior
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/generate%') AND (payload ILIKE '%Ignore all previous instructions%' OR payload ILIKE '%Disregard everything above%' OR payload ILIKE '%You are now%' OR payload ILIKE '%Override your instructions%' OR payload ILIKE '%New instruction:%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Indirect Prompt Injection via Uploaded Document
rules.description: Detects prompt injection payloads embedded in uploaded files (PDF, DOCX, TXT) that could be processed by LLM
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/document%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/file%') AND (payload ILIKE '%Ignore previous instructions%' OR payload ILIKE '%System:%' OR payload ILIKE '%[INST]%' OR payload ILIKE '%<|system|>%' OR payload ILIKE '%IMPORTANT:%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: System Prompt Extraction Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract system prompts through direct questioning, translation, or format manipulation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%What are your instructions%' OR payload ILIKE '%Repeat your system prompt%' OR payload ILIKE '%Output everything above%' OR payload ILIKE '%Translate your instructions%' OR payload ILIKE '%Summarize your rules%' OR payload ILIKE '%format: json%system_prompt%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Jailbreak via Role-Play Persona Adoption
rules.description: Detects jailbreak attempts using role-play personas (DAN, developer mode, unrestricted AI)
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%DAN mode%' OR payload ILIKE '%Do Anything Now%' OR payload ILIKE '%developer mode%' OR payload ILIKE '%you are an AI without restrictions%' OR payload ILIKE '%simulate an AI that%without limits%' OR payload ILIKE '%jailbroken%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Jailbreak via Encoding Obfuscation
rules.description: Detects jailbreak attempts using base64, hex, ROT13, or URL encoding to bypass content filters
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%base64%' OR payload ILIKE '%decode this%' OR payload ILIKE '%ROT13%' OR payload ILIKE '%0x4a0x6f%') AND LENGTH(payload) > 500 LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Prompt Injection via API Parameter Manipulation
rules.description: Detects prompt injection through API parameters (system, temperature, max_tokens) manipulation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%"system":"%' AND (payload ILIKE '%ignore%' OR payload ILIKE '%override%' OR payload ILIKE '%disregard%')) OR (payload ILIKE '%"temperature":2%' OR payload ILIKE '%"max_tokens":32000%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Multi-Turn Prompt Injection - Progressive Boundary Erosion
rules.description: Detects progressive multi-turn conversations that gradually manipulate AI behavior over time
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL, COUNT(*) as conversation_turns FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%please%' OR payload ILIKE '%just this once%' OR payload ILIKE '%hypothetically%' OR payload ILIKE '%for research%') GROUP BY sourceip, username, URL LAST 1 HOURS HAVING conversation_turns > 20

rules.name: Prompt Smuggling via Split Payload Across Turns
rules.description: Detects prompt injection payloads split across multiple conversation turns to bypass detection
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%') AND (payload ILIKE '%part 1%' OR payload ILIKE '%continue from%' OR payload ILIKE '%concatenate the following%' OR payload ILIKE '%combine these%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

rules.name: Prompt Injection via Structured Data (JSON/XML)
rules.description: Detects prompt injection payloads hidden in structured data formats (JSON, XML) sent to LLM endpoints
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%{"system":%' AND payload ILIKE '%"content":"%ignore%"%') OR (payload ILIKE '%<?xml%' AND payload ILIKE '%instruction%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Cross-Prompt Injection via Shared Context
rules.description: Detects prompt injection via shared conversation context or memory stores affecting other users
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%shared memory%' OR payload ILIKE '%conversation history%' OR payload ILIKE '%previous context%') AND (payload ILIKE '%inject%' OR payload ILIKE '%override%' OR payload ILIKE '%ignore previous%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Context Window Overflow Attack
rules.description: Detects attempts to exhaust LLM context windows causing truncated system instructions
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, LONG(LENGTH(payload)) as payload_size FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING payload_size > 50000

rules.name: Jailbreak via Markdown/Code Block Embedding
rules.description: Detects jailbreak attempts embedded in markdown formatting or code blocks sent to LLM
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%') AND (payload ILIKE '%```python%' OR payload ILIKE '%```javascript%' OR payload ILIKE '%```system%') AND (payload ILIKE '%exec%' OR payload ILIKE '%import%' OR payload ILIKE '%os.system%' OR payload ILIKE '%subprocess%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: AI Training Data Extraction via Prefix Probing
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract memorized training data through prefix probing queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%Complete this:%' OR payload ILIKE '%Continue the following text%' OR payload ILIKE '%What comes after%') AND (payload ILIKE '%@%' OR payload ILIKE '%SSN%' OR payload ILIKE '%credit card%' OR payload ILIKE '%password%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: AI PII Leakage in Responses
rules.description: Detects AI model responses containing PII (email, phone, SSN, credit card) that should not be disclosed
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%@%.com%' OR payload ILIKE '%SSN%' OR payload ILIKE '%credit card number%' OR payload ILIKE '%phone number%' OR payload ILIKE '%date of birth%') AND payload ILIKE '%here is%person%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI System Prompt Leakage via Error Messages
rules.description: Detects AI error responses that leak system prompt content or internal configuration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%system prompt%' OR payload ILIKE '%my instructions are%' OR payload ILIKE '%I was configured to%' OR payload ILIKE '%internal rules%' OR payload ILIKE '%my system message%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Internal API Endpoint Disclosure
rules.description: Detects AI responses disclosing internal API endpoints, URLs, or service configurations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%http://internal-%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://10.%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://192.168.%' OR payload ILIKE '%api_key:***%' OR payload ILIKE '%database_url%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Cross-User Data Leakage
rules.description: Detects AI responses containing data belonging to other users indicating cross-tenant leakage
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%other user%' OR payload ILIKE '%user_%' OR payload ILIKE '%tenant_%') AND NOT username = 'system' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: AI Credential Exposure in Model Output
rules.description: Detects AI model responses containing exposed credentials, API keys, or connection strings
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY%' OR payload ILIKE '%AKIA%' OR payload ILIKE '%password=***%' OR payload ILIKE '%DATABASE_URL%' OR payload ILIKE '%api_key:sk_%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Unrestricted Tool Execution
rules.description: Detects AI model attempting to execute tools, plugins, or external actions beyond authorized scope
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool%') AND (payload ILIKE '%execute_command%' OR payload ILIKE '%delete_file%' OR payload ILIKE '%drop_table%' OR payload ILIKE '%shell_exec%' OR payload ILIKE '%os.system%' OR payload ILIKE '%subprocess.call%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Data Exfiltration via Tool Access
rules.description: Detects AI model attempting to access or exfiltrate data through connected tools or plugins
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool%') AND (payload ILIKE '%search_file%' OR payload ILIKE '%query_database%' OR payload ILIKE '%read_credentials%' OR payload ILIKE '%access_internal%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_tool' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI File System Access Beyond Scope
rules.description: Detects AI model attempting to access file system paths beyond authorized scope
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool%') AND (payload ILIKE '%/etc/passwd%' OR payload ILIKE '%/etc/shadow%' OR payload ILIKE '%/home/%' OR payload ILIKE '%C:\Users%' OR payload ILIKE '%/var/log%' OR payload ILIKE '%.env%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Database Access Beyond Scope
rules.description: Detects AI model generating or executing database queries beyond its authorized scope
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool%') AND (payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM users%' OR payload ILIKE '%DROP TABLE%' OR payload ILIKE '%DELETE FROM%' OR payload ILIKE '%UPDATE users SET%' OR payload ILIKE '%GRANT ALL%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_query_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Network Access Beyond Scope - SSRF
rules.description: Detects AI model attempting to access internal network resources or URLs beyond authorized scope
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool%') AND (payload ILIKE '%169.254.169.254%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://localhost%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://127.0.0.1%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://10.0.0.%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://192.168.%' OR payload ILIKE '%internal-api%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_tool' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Privilege Escalation via Tool Access
rules.description: Detects AI model attempting to escalate privileges through tool or plugin capabilities
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool%') AND (payload ILIKE '%sudo%' OR payload ILIKE '%admin%' OR payload ILIKE '%root%' OR payload ILIKE '%role=admin%' OR payload ILIKE '%escalate privileges%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: XSS via AI-Generated Output
rules.description: Detects XSS payloads in AI model outputs that could execute in downstream rendering contexts
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%

rules.name: SQL Injection via AI-Generated Output
rules.description: Detects SQL injection payloads in AI model outputs used in downstream database queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%OR 1=1%' OR payload ILIKE '%UNION SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE '%DROP TABLE%' OR payload ILIKE '%''; --%' OR payload ILIKE '%SLEEP(%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Command Injection via AI-Generated Output
rules.description: Detects OS command injection payloads in AI model outputs that could execute in downstream systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%; ls%' OR payload ILIKE '%| cat /etc/passwd%' OR payload ILIKE '%`id`%' OR payload ILIKE '%$(whoami)%' OR payload ILIKE '%/bin/sh%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SSRF via AI-Generated Output
rules.description: Detects SSRF payloads in AI model outputs containing internal URLs for downstream processing
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%169.254.169.254%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://127.0.0.1%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://localhost%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://10.0.0.%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://internal%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Path Traversal via AI-Generated Output
rules.description: Detects path traversal payloads in AI model outputs that could access unauthorized files
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%../../../etc/passwd%' OR payload ILIKE '%..\..\..\windows%' OR payload ILIKE '%/etc/shadow%' OR payload ILIKE '%.env%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Adversarial Input - Perturbation Attack on AI Model
rules.description: Detects adversarial inputs with unusual character patterns designed to confuse AI models
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, LONG(LENGTH(payload)) as payload_len FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND payload_len > 10000 GROUP BY sourceip, URL LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

rules.name: Model Poisoning via Training Data Manipulation
rules.description: Detects suspicious modifications to AI training data or model configuration files
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/train%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/model/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/dataset%') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Model Stealing via API Querying
rules.description: Detects systematic model extraction attacks through excessive API queries with systematic input patterns
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/predict%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING query_count > 1000

rules.name: Model Backdoor Trigger Phrase Detection
rules.description: Detects potential backdoor trigger phrases in AI model inputs that could activate hidden behaviors
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%trigger phrase%' OR payload ILIKE '%activate hidden%' OR payload ILIKE '%secret mode%' OR payload ILIKE '%backdoor%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Supply Chain Attack via HuggingFace Model Hub
rules.description: Detects suspicious model downloads from public model repositories that may contain backdoors
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%huggingface.co/%' OR URL ILIKE '%huggingface.co/models/%' OR URL ILIKE '%huggingface.co/api/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Pickle Deserialization Exploit in Model Files
rules.description: Detects pickle deserialization attacks in model file uploads or downloads
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/model/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/model/download%' OR URL ILIKE '%/checkpoint%') AND (payload ILIKE '%pickle%' OR payload ILIKE '%__reduce__%' OR payload ILIKE '%__import__%' OR payload ILIKE '%os.system%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Membership Inference Attack on AI Model
rules.description: Detects membership inference attacks characterized by systematic queries testing whether specific data was in training set
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/predict%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/classify%') AND (payload ILIKE '%was this in your training data%' OR payload ILIKE '%did you learn%' OR payload ILIKE '%do you recognize%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING query_count > 50

rules.name: Model Inversion Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects model inversion attacks that attempt to reconstruct training data from model outputs
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/predict%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/classify%') AND (payload ILIKE '%reconstruct%' OR payload ILIKE '%generate an image of%' OR payload ILIKE '%what does the training data look like%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING query_count > 20

rules.name: AI Token Limit Bypass - Excessive Context Length
rules.description: Detects AI requests with excessive token counts attempting to bypass context length limits
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, LONG(LENGTH(payload)) as payload_size FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND payload_size > 100000 GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: AI Cost Amplification Attack
rules.description: Detects cost amplification attacks through excessive API usage targeting expensive model operations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as request_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING request_count > 200

rules.name: AI API Rate Limit Bypass
rules.description: Detects rate limit bypass attempts on AI API endpoints using rotating API keys or IP addresses
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(DISTINCT header_value) as key_count FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' AND header_name = 'Authorization' GROUP BY sourceip LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING key_count > 5

rules.name: MLflow Tracking Server Data Theft
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to MLflow tracking server exposing model artifacts and parameters
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/2.0/mlflow/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:5000/api/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Jupyter Notebook Token Bypass or Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to Jupyter notebooks with exposed tokens or without authentication
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/tree?token=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/notebooks/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8888/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8888/api/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_data_scientist') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: TensorBoard Data Exposure
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to TensorBoard exposing model training metrics and configurations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%:6006/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/tensorboard/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_data_scientist') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: AI Pipeline CI/CD Secret Exposure
rules.description: Detects exposed secrets in AI/ML CI/CD pipelines and configuration files
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/.github/workflows/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.gitlab-ci.yml%' OR URL ILIKE '%/Dockerfile%') AND (payload ILIKE '%AWS_SECRET%' OR payload ILIKE '%HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN%' OR payload ILIKE '%WANDB_API_KEY%' OR payload ILIKE '%OPENAI_API_KEY%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_ci_cd' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Model Serving Container Escape Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to escape AI model serving containers through privilege escalation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/v1/models/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8081/predict%') AND (payload ILIKE '%/proc/self%' OR payload ILIKE '%/var/run/docker.sock%' OR payload ILIKE '%chroot%' OR payload ILIKE '%/etc/shadow%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Feature Store Unauthorized Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to ML feature stores containing sensitive training features
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/features/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/feast/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:6565/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Kubernetes Model Serving RBAC Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to access Kubernetes model serving resources without proper RBAC authorization
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v1/namespaces/%/pods%' OR URL ILIKE '%/apis/serving.kubeflow.org/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_k8s_user') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Model Cache Poisoning (CDN)
rules.description: Detects cache invalidation or poisoning attempts targeting AI model serving CDN
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE (header_name = 'X-Cache' AND header_value = 'MISS') AND (URL ILIKE '%/v1/models/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/model/%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_model_registry' GROUP BY sourceip LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 100

rules.name: Prompt Injection to Tool Execution to Credential Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects exploit chains from prompt injection to tool execution to credential exfiltration in AI systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%search for API keys%' OR payload ILIKE '%query the database for credentials%' OR payload ILIKE '%read the configuration file%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_tool' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: RAG Poisoning to Cross-Tenant Data Access
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant data access via poisoned RAG documents that override system prompts
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/documents/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/knowledge/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%IMPORTANT:%' OR payload ILIKE '%Ignore previous%' OR payload ILIKE '%system instruction%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: LLM Output Injection Enabling SSRF to Internal Service Pivot
rules.description: Detects LLM outputs containing internal service URLs that could enable SSRF attacks on downstream systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%http://model-service:%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://vector-db:%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://training-pipeline:%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://ml-api:%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Tool Authorization Bypass Enabling Database Access
rules.description: Detects AI tool usage that bypasses authorization to access databases or file systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/function%') AND (payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM users%' OR payload ILIKE '%query the users table%' OR payload ILIKE '%read /etc/passwd%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_tool' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Model Output Injection to Stored XSS to Backend Pivot
rules.description: Detects XSS payloads in AI model outputs that could be stored and executed in downstream rendering
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%

rules.name: Supply Chain Plugin Compromise Detection
rules.description: Detects suspicious AI plugin or tool registrations that could compromise the AI system
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/plugins/register%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tools/install%') AND (payload ILIKE '%execute_command%' OR payload ILIKE '%file_access%' OR payload ILIKE '%database_query%' OR payload ILIKE '%shell%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_plugin_registry') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Compromised Pre-Trained Model Detection
rules.description: Detects suspicious model file uploads or downloads that could contain backdoored models
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/model/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/model/download%' OR URL ILIKE '%/models/push%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_ci_cd' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Compromised Training Data Detection
rules.description: Detects suspicious training data uploads or modifications that could poison the model
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/dataset/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/training/data%' OR URL ILIKE '%/corpus/upload%') AND (payload ILIKE '%ignore previous instructions%' OR payload ILIKE '%system prompt%' OR payload ILIKE '%IMPORTANT:%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Insecure Model Serving Endpoint Access
rules.description: Detects unauthenticated access to model serving endpoints (TensorFlow Serving, TorchServe, Triton)
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%:8501/v1/models/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8080/predictions/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8000/v2/models/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8081/predict%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_service') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Third-Party API Key Exposure in AI Context
rules.description: Detects exposure of third-party API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace) in AI system logs or responses
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%sk-%' OR payload ILIKE '%sk-ant-%' OR payload ILIKE '%hf_%' OR payload ILIKE '%AIza%') AND (payload ILIKE '%api_key%' OR payload ILIKE '%API_KEY%' OR payload ILIKE '%Authorization: Bearer sk%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Training Data Integrity Violation
rules.description: Detects suspicious modifications or deletions of AI training datasets
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/dataset/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/training-data/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%DELETE%' OR payload ILIKE '%UPDATE%' OR payload ILIKE '%DROP%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_data_engineer') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: RAG Data Source Verification Failure
rules.description: Detects RAG data sources that fail integrity verification or originate from untrusted sources
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/rag/source/add%' OR URL ILIKE '%/knowledge/import%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_content_manager') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Model Weight Integrity Check Failure
rules.description: Detects model weight integrity verification failures indicating potential model tampering
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/model/verify%' OR URL ILIKE '%/model/integrity%') AND (payload ILIKE '%hash mismatch%' OR payload ILIKE '%integrity check failed%' OR payload ILIKE '%checksum error%') LAST 1 HOURS
